method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stock futures rise as traders digest Big Tech earnings and hope to recover from Fed Day sell-off:...
Equities.reason: Intraday bounce after a Fed-driven sell-off — signals tentative risk-on as traders digest Big Tech earnings. Relevant to overall equity sentiment but modestly directional.

Equities.title: Stock Market Today: Bond Selloff Extends; Oil Ticks Higher
Equities.reason: Extension of bond selloff (yields up) = negative for growth/equities and undercuts risk appetite; strong macro headwind post-Fed.

Equities.title: Nasdaq 100 Enters Correction, S&P 500 Falls After Fed Decision
Equities.reason: Major equity index correction driven by Fed decision and sector-led selloff (semiconductors/tech) — high-impact for market regime and risk sentiment.

Equities.title: US Stocks Rise as Microsoft Counters Bond Rout: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Mega-cap leadership (Microsoft) is cushioning the wider bond-led rout — supports concentrated market internals and explains divergence between indices.

Equities.title: Microsoft jumps 8% as it boosts capital spending plans, citing demand
Equities.summary: Microsoft sees positive free cash flow for the new fiscal year as it changes accounting for data centers and office buildings.
Equities.reason: Strong beat and raised capex/data-center plans reinforce AI leadership narrative and support mega-cap equity performance — material positive for market leadership dynamics.

Equities.title: Meta shares tumble as Zuckerberg tries to sell his vision for AI ‘agents’
Equities.summary: Social media chief defends strategy based on personalised bots as costs rise and revenue projections disappoint
Equities.reason: Large cap disappointment on AI monetization raises concerns over high AI investment vs near-term revenue — negative for tech sentiment and growth stocks.

Equities.title: Chinese Chip Stocks Plunge as Investors Rotate Away From Tech
Equities.reason: Sector-wide selloff in China-listed chip names signals reversal of 'AI picks-and-shovels' theme and amplifies global tech downside risk; raises contagion to global equities.

Equities.title: Chinese stocks on track for worst month in decade
Equities.summary: Investors pull out of ‘picks and shovels’ suppliers to AI boom
Equities.reason: Broad China equity outflows and sector rotation compound global risk-off; meaningful for EM/Asia equity regime and flows.

Equities.title: LSEG Boosts Guidance as AI Rollout Adds to Record First Half
Equities.reason: Positive company-level confirmation that AI monetization is supporting earnings — reinforces AI leadership narrative for certain data/financials names.

Equities.title: Rolls-Royce hikes guidance as it benefits from both the defense boom and AI data center buildout
Equities.summary: Orders in the company's data center power business grew more than 50% in the first half of the year.
Equities.reason: Industrial beneficiary of data-center/AI capex — positive for cyclicals tied to AI infrastructure, but narrower stock-specific impact.

Equities.title: US launches strikes on Iran after Trump vows to deliver ‘beating’
Equities.summary: Attack comes day after Tehran launched ballistic missiles at American forces
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation raises risk premia and could pressure risk assets broadly; material regional/commodity channels but also compresses risk appetite for equities.

Equities.title: Chinese Firms Ready Most Buybacks Since Trade War to Stem Rout
Equities.reason: Corporate buybacks aimed at stabilising Chinese equity markets — a potential mitigating force for EM/China downside and relevant to regional flows.

Rates.title: Analysis: Fed Chairman Warsh's credibility in question after leaving interest rates unchanged
Rates.summary: The Fed held interest rates steady, but long-term Treasury yields jumped. Investors are questioning whether he will act forcefully enough on inflation.
Rates.reason: Direct rates story: Fed pause accompanied by a jump in long-term Treasury yields. Signals a bond selloff and investor doubt about Fed resolve — negative for bonds (yields up). High relevance because it captures market reaction to the FOMC decision and policymaker credibility.

Rates.title: US borrowing costs hit 19-year high as Fed defies inflation fears
Rates.summary: Central bank holds rates even as investors worry Iran war will ignite jolt of price growth
Rates.reason: Rates-focused: headline indicates a large rise in borrowing costs (19-year high) driven by Fed hold and geopolitical inflation risk — clear bond-selloff signal. Very relevant to market-wide yield move.

Rates.title: Bond Rout Sends Warning to Warsh That Tough Talk Is Not Enough
Rates.reason: Explicit bond-market narrative: a rout in Treasuries undermining Fed communications. Strong negative direction (yields higher) and high relevance because it describes market-driven repricing of policy expectations.

Rates.title: Bond market is calling Warsh’s bluff on inflation fight as yields surge
Rates.reason: Title signals yields surging and the bond market pressing the Fed — negative for bonds. Medium relevance as it reinforces the dominant theme of market-driven higher yields.

Rates.title: Fed’s Warsh Rebuked by Investors Craving a Real Inflation Fight
Rates.reason: Investor backlash to Fed posture implies higher term premia/yields as markets doubt policy tightening — negative for bonds. High relevance given Bloomberg's market-focused framing.

Rates.title: Government Borrowing Cost Hits Two-Decade High After Fed Rate Decision
Rates.reason: Headline explicitly notes a sharp rise in government borrowing costs after the Fed decision — clear negative for bond prices. Strong relevance as it signals a major move in yields.

Rates.title: Fed Doubts Push Some Funds to Eye Overseas Bets Over Treasuries
Rates.reason: Flow/positioning piece: funds looking away from Treasuries toward overseas bonds amid doubts on Fed policy — negative for UST demand and bond prices. Moderate relevance as it describes capital-flow response to yield repricing.

Rates.title: Morning Bid: Bond markets doing the Fed's work
Rates.reason: Reuters market commentary frames bond-market repricing as tightening financial conditions in lieu of policy — negative for bonds. Moderately relevant because it synthesizes market action post-Fed.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Primary-source policy release. Neutral-to-slightly-negative in this window because the statement accompanied market-driven yield increases; included for policy context with straightforward relevance.

Rates.title: Fed holds rates steady, extending pause as markets await Kevin Warsh's policy roadmap
Rates.reason: Coverage of the Fed hold and market anticipation of future guidance. Slightly negative for bonds given the accompanying yields spike, but lower relevance due to publisher's crypto focus and lack of detailed rates analysis.

Rates.title: Equities: Fed-driven yield spike pressures equities – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank notes that the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) on-hold decision and limited detail from Chair Warsh sparked a sharp steepening in the Treasury curve, pushing the 30-year yield to 5.20% and weighing on equities.
Rates.reason: Although framed for equities, the article contains explicit Treasury curve and 30y yield detail — negative for bonds. Included for cross-market evidence of steepening and higher long-end yields.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Extended pause with 2027 cuts – UOB
Rates.summary: UOB’s Suan Teck Kin and Alvin Liew analyze the latest FOMC decision, noting the Fed Funds Target Rate remains at 3.50%-3.75% for a fifth straight meeting despite three dissenting votes favoring a hike.
Rates.reason: Analyst view implying cuts in 2027 (longer-dated easing priced in) is bond-friendly (positive for bond prices). Included as a lower-relevance counter-signal to the near-term selloff.

Rates.title: What a divided Fed means for investors
Rates.summary: Wall Street has a clear takeaway from this week's Federal Reserve decision: A hike is likely on the horizon.
Rates.reason: Interpretation piece arguing Fed division signals a higher-for-longer rates path. Slightly negative for bonds; moderate relevance as it reflects market expectations shaping yield curves.

FX.title: US Dollar: Real yields drive correction risk – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner notes that US real yields and the US Dollar (USD) fell after a confusing FOMC press conference, as markets sensed the Federal Reserve (Fed) may avoid further tightening.
FX.reason: Fed communication and US real yields are primary drivers of broad USD moves. ING highlights USD weakness tied to real yields and Fed messaging — a high-relevance macro theme that supports USD softness (positive direction for USD crosses).

FX.title: Euro: Fed split supports EUR against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s FX Research team, including Charlie Lay and colleagues, notes that the Dollar Index fell and EUR/USD climbed after the Federal Reserve left rates unchanged but revealed a significant internal split.
FX.reason: Direct FX-focused take: Fed's internal split and DXY weakness lifted EUR/USD. This reinforces the prevailing post-FOMC narrative that USD has softened, making this a meaningful EUR-support signal for FX positioning.

FX.title: Euro: Data-driven range trade into Q3 against US Dollar – ING
FX.summary: Chris Turner at ING writes that EUR/USD bounced modestly after the FOMC but was constrained by higher long-dated US yields and pressure on US growth stocks.
FX.reason: Balanced FX view: EUR had a modest post-FOMC bounce but long-dated US yields limit upside. Signals a range-bound EUR/USD in near term — relevant to USD-driven ranges but not a one-sided regime shift.

FX.title: British Pound declines as Fed hawkish rate holds boost US Dollar, BoE rate decision looms
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some sellers to near 1.3345 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the British Pound (GBP) amid hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) signals and escalating Middle East tensions.
FX.reason: Article points to USD strength versus GBP driven by hawkish Fed signals and geopolitical risk — a clear USD-supportive headline that pressures GBP/USD (negative direction for USD crosses).

FX.title: US GDP expected to grow at 2.1% in Q2, unshaken by Iran conflict
FX.summary: The United States (US) Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) is set to publish its preliminary estimate of second-quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP) on Thursday, with analysts expecting the data to show annualised growth at a solid 2.1%, a modest cooling from th
FX.reason: A stronger-than-expected US GDP print would be USD-supportive via growth/yield channels. This macro datapoint is directly relevant to the USD outlook and tilts the narrative toward USD strength if confirmed.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Rebounds to near 101.00 as bullish bias prevails
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is gaining ground after two days of losses and trading around 101.00 during the European hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY technical rebound signals renewed USD strength. As a price-forecast piece (technical), relevance is capped but it still conveys short-term USD upside risk that matters to FX positioning.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar gains ground above 0.5800 as Fed hold mutes US Dollar
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.5810 during early European trading hours on Thursday, bolstered by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) rate hike bets.
FX.reason: Illustrates how Fed guidance and local RBNZ rate expectations are enabling NZD outperformance vs USD. Relevant as a G10 example of USD softening flows, but narrower in scope than the Fed-wide narrative.

FX.title: British Pound: BoE hike pricing supports Sterling against US Dollar – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG's Derek Halpenny notes that the British Pound (GBP) has been the strongest G10 currency after the US Dollar (USD) since the Middle East conflict began, with attention now on the Bank of England’s (BoE) July decision.
FX.reason: BoE hike expectations are a live local driver for GBP vs USD. This supports a GBP-positive narrative that competes with Fed-driven USD moves; relevant to G10 flows ahead of the BoE decision.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Rising 20-day EMA backs bullish bias
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair trades 0.1% higher at around 163.60 during the European trading session on Thursday. The pair rises as the US Dollar (USD) regains ground due to intensifying military aggression between the United States (US) and Iran.
FX.reason: USD/JPY movement often signals broader USD risk sentiment. Here USD strength tied to geopolitical escalation is relevant, but as a technical/price-forecast piece its relevance is moderate.

FX.title: German flash Q2 GDP rises 0.2% QoQ, beats 0.1% estimates
FX.summary: German preliminary Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rises at a 0.2% pace, beating the estimates of 0.1%, according to the Federal Statistics Office of Germany. However, the GDP growth remains slower than the previous reading of 0.3%.
FX.reason: Stronger German Q2 GDP is a direct positive for EUR vs USD via growth differentials. It's a domestic euro-area macro datapoint that modestly bolsters the EUR narrative after the FOMC move.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil extends gains beyond $84.00 as US resumes strikes in Iran
Commodities.summary: Oil prices have risen about 7% over the last two days, pushing the price of the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (WTI) barrel to levels above $84.00 on Thursday, up from the $77.16 lows seen earlier in the week.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation (US strikes in/against Iran) is a clear supply-risk shock for crude. Strong, near-term bullish driver for WTI; high relevance given rapid price moves and market attention.

Commodities.title: Oil Holds Gain as Trump Vows to Hit Iran and US Stockpiles Slump
Commodities.reason: Combines renewed geopolitical risk (threats to Iran) with falling US stockpiles — reinforcing a bullish oil narrative. High macro/market-moving relevance for crude.

Commodities.title: Brent oil jumps back above $90 after Trump threatens to hit Iran hard
Commodities.summary: Oil rose sharply amid renewed tensions in the Middle East after Iran launched an attack on U.S. forces using ballistic missiles.
Commodities.reason: Another confirmation of the same Middle East supply-risk impulse pushing Brent higher; meaningful but somewhat redundant with other Iran-related reports so slightly lower relevance.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Inventory build is a near-term bearish datapoint for crude. Relevance moderate — a fundamental counter-signal to the geopolitical-driven price strength.

Commodities.title: Refined Fuels, Not Crude, Are Driving the Oil Market Crunch
Commodities.reason: Article highlights tightness in refined products (gasoline/diesel) which supports RBOB/gasoline markets even if crude fundamentals are mixed — constructive for refined fuels prices and refining margins.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New LNG export capacity increases available export supply to global gas markets — modest bearish impulse for regional/spot natural gas prices. Relevance moderate given scale (0.4 Bcf/d).

Commodities.title: Gold bears retain control as USD strengthens on Fed hike bets and Mideast crisis
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone through the first half of the European session on Thursday and seems vulnerable to following an intraday rejection near the $4,100 mark.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-action piece showing dollar strength and Fed-hike bets dominating gold's reaction despite geopolitical tailwinds. Net bearish narrative for gold in near term.

Commodities.title: Central Banks Bought Far Less Gold Than Thought at Start of Year
Commodities.reason: Lower-than-expected central-bank demand reduces a structural source of gold buying — a meaningful negative fundamental signal for gold's medium-term demand picture.

Commodities.title: Binance offers gold and silver options after commodity futures pull in billions in daily volume
Commodities.reason: Expanded retail/institutional access to gold and silver options via a major crypto venue increases liquidity and optionality — modestly constructive for precious-metals market structure and flows.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD turns upside down amid soaring US Treasury Yields
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gives back its early gains and turns negative on Thursday. The white metal trades 0.7% lower at around $57.25 in the European trade after a positive start, which led to hitting an intraday high at $58.65.
Commodities.reason: Price-forecast / intraday technical piece tying silver weakness to rising U.S. Treasury yields. By framework, technical/forecast pieces get capped relevance; sign is negative given yield-induced selling.

Commodities.title: Hormuz Shipping Traffic Picks Up Despite Middle East Hostilities
Commodities.reason: Rising shipping traffic through Hormuz despite hostilities could mitigate crude supply-flow disruption risk and cap the oil risk premium — a modest bearish/tempering signal versus the dominant geopolitical squeeze.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, July 28, 2026: Crypto prices slide ahead of Fed meeting
Crypto.reason: Headline ties crypto price weakness directly to upcoming Fed policy risk. Short-term negative for risk assets (BTC/ETH) as investors delever into a rate-sensitive event.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin analysts agree the Fed's hold was hawkish. They are split on what happens next.
Crypto.reason: Consensus that Fed was hawkish reinforces a higher-for-longer rates narrative, a broad negative for crypto as a risk asset and for flows into spot/derivative markets.

Crypto.title: Robinhood slides 4% despite earnings beat as crypto revenue cools
Crypto.reason: Platform-level revenue cooling implies weaker retail crypto activity/volumes — negative for short-term demand and fee-based ecosystem revenues.

Crypto.title: Crypto Long & Short: What this year's $972 million crypto hacks actually tell us about security
Crypto.reason: Large cumulative hack losses materially raise counterparty/security concerns, damaging confidence and potentially reducing on-chain activity and institutional appetite.

Crypto.title: 3 reasons Wednesday's Fed meeting is pivotal for BTC
Crypto.reason: Explains direct transmission channels (rates, dollar, liquidity) from Fed policy to BTC — reinforces near-term downside sensitivity to hawkish outcomes.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin steadies above $64,000 as crypto looks to Fed interest-rate decision
Crypto.reason: Price stabilisation noted but story frames action as Fed-driven; modestly negative because the dominant risk is policy uncertainty rather than clear bullish catalysts.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether whipsaw wipes out $280 million even as prices remain flat over 24 hours
Crypto.reason: Large intraday liquidations highlight elevated volatility and leverage risk in futures/perpetual markets — negative for short-term risk appetite and funding stability.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's quantum plan assumes some algorithms break. AI just weakened one in 60 hours
Crypto.reason: Technical-security story: AI reduced effort to weaken an algorithmic assumption — introduces longer-term cryptographic risk and potential need for protocol changes, negative for confidence.

Crypto.title: Senators ready to send stricter ethics rules on Trump's crypto ventures to White House, sources say
Crypto.reason: Political/regulatory attention focused on crypto-related ventures raises policy risk and uncertainty — negative for market sentiment and potential regulatory costs.

Crypto.title: As crypto perpetual futures boom, Ethereum’s role is shifting
Crypto.reason: Growth of perpetual markets and a changing role for ETH point to deepening market structure, more liquidity and new demand channels — constructive for ETH and derivatives markets.

Crypto.title: The systemic-risk debate over perpetual futures is aimed at the wrong target
Crypto.reason: Opinion piece arguing the market may be misdiagnosing risks — slightly positive because it could lessen the chance of heavy-handed regulatory action against perpetuals.

Crypto.title: Stablecoin firm Brale says new protocol can remove a major hurdle to scaling custom tokens
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level improvement that eases scaling of custom tokens/stablecoins supports broader on-chain payments and DeFi growth — positive adoption signal.

Crypto.title: BNY targets $8.6 trillion transfer agency market on blockchain rails
Crypto.reason: Major incumbent bank pursuing large-scale blockchain use is a meaningful institutional adoption signal, materially positive for long-term crypto infrastructure demand.

Crypto.title: Company behind AI trade that caused $60 million crypto liquidations to cover all losses
Crypto.reason: AI-driven trading caused notable liquidations, but the firm's pledge to cover losses reduces systemic spillover; net effect modestly negative for market trust/volatility.

Crypto.title: About $80 million ZEC crosses into Zcash's new Ironwood pool in the first day
Crypto.reason: Significant migration into a new protocol pool for a privacy coin signals user engagement and network activity, but impact is limited relative to BTC/ETH market-wide flows.
